import re

import pytest

from blib2to3.pgen2 import literals


def _match_escape(text: str) -> re.Match[str]:
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\\(.*)", text)
    assert match is not None
    return match


def test_escape_returns_simple_escape():
    assert literals.escape(_match_escape(r"\n")) == "\n"


def test_escape_decodes_valid_hex_escape():
    assert literals.escape(_match_escape(r"\x41")) == "A"


def test_escape_rejects_short_hex_escape():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
        literals.escape(_match_escape(r"\x"))

def test_escape_rejects_invalid_hex_escape():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:

def test_escape_decodes_valid_octal_escape():
